config.scope: Single-intent benchmark; five labeled business/control routes, no product_inquiry or ambiguity gold labels.
config.confidence_policy: LLM self-assessment recorded as emitted; classifier threshold 0.6 is not applied.
config.timing: One synthetic warmup excluded. Per-case wall latency includes local HTTP, server tokenization and generation; initial model loading excluded.
config.cost: Local inference, no paid API. GPU cost requires a declared hourly rate; it is not invented.

metrics.note: Schema validation checks shape, not factual/business correctness. Gold slots/status/actions are unavailable, so their semantic accuracy is not scored.
